title: Basilica of Sainte-Anne-de-Beaupré
scope: Standing exterior of the Basilica of Sainte-Anne-de-Beaupré, including its paired bell towers, rose window, stepped entrance, aisled nave, transepts and semicircular ambulatory chapels.
limitations: Only the standing exterior is represented. Individual bronze-door reliefs and figurative sculptures are suggested in geometry. The glass patterns, side buttress returns and roof details are simplified.
The basilica annexes, plaza sculpture and earlier buildings on the sanctuary property are separate structures.
